entry.title: JP Morgan Strategist on AI Jitters, Investing Outlook
entry.summary: Jordan Jackson, JPMorgan Asset Management Global Market Strategist, discusses whether earnings growth may be nearing a peak even if results are not worsening. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
